BUSINESS STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.
   D. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

4. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   C. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.

5. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   C. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   B. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   D. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.
   C. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.

9. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   C. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Marketing as rumours only.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

11. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   B. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   D. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.

13. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

14. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.
   B. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.
   D. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   C. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer and Investor Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Regulators in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Planning and Development in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain International Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Price Determination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Procurement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
